title: Smoke Show Sportfishing
specs: 54’ Custom Carolina sportfish boat, one of the largest charter boats in Virginia Beach
includes: Fishing tackle, safety equipment, navigational technology, marine electronics
blurb: Smoke Show is a 54’ Custom Carolina sportfish boat designed for comfortable offshore fishing trips for up to six anglers. The boat is equipped with modern fishing tackle, safety gear, navigational technology, a climate-controlled cabin, and restroom facilities. Charters operate in Oregon Inlet from March to May and in Virginia Beach from June to October, targeting seasonal fish species.
extraNote: 10% deposit required, balance due before boat leaves dock · Accepts cash, check, credit/debit card, PayPal, Venmo · Docked at Mimi’s Tiki Hut in Pirates Cove, NC (spring) and Rudee’s Cabana Bar in Virginia Beach, VA (summer) · March through October
